controls.title: 01. Geometric parameter controls
controls.g3DerivedFlangeRadius: A drive-side hole-circle radius (derived from parallel spacing)
controls.flangeGeometryHelp: Radius only controls the flange-hole circle in the drawing; it is not a physical flange outer diameter. Center offsets in mm update the axial profile below.
controls.g3FlangeGeometryHelp: For G3, the A-side hole-circle radius is derived from the parallel spacing. PCD is the diameter through spoke-hole centers, not the flange's outside edge. The B-side circle and axial offsets remain independently adjustable.
controls.g3ParallelHoleSpacing: Center distance of the paired drive-spoke holes
controls.g3GroupSpacingHelp: Enter the center distance of the paired drive-side spoke holes. The corresponding rim-hole pair and A-flange-hole pair use the same distance; the backend derives the A-flange hole-circle radius from its 14-hole spacing and positions the rim holes to match. No angle input is needed.
controls.g3DerivedFlangeSize: Derived from this spacing: A-flange hole-circle radius {radius} mm, hole-circle diameter (PCD) {pcd} mm.
controls.g3ParallelSpacingInvalid: Enter a positive value within the supported range; the drawing keeps the last valid result.

canvas.title: 02. Wheelset geometric vector blueprint viewport
canvas.profileAria: Axial reference profile for the two wheel hub flanges
canvas.profileRuntime: A drive-side center offset {driveOffset} mm, B non-drive center offset {nonDriveOffset} mm, total flange span {total} mm; geometry reference only.
canvas.aria: Wheelset lacing topology geometry preview; the default 24H 1:1, 2X crossing, and dual-flange line mapping are shown
canvas.ariaRuntime: Wheelset lacing topology geometry preview for {selection}, {cross}; the drawing shows hole and spoke relationships only

review.title: 03. Topology preview status
review.backendPendingDetail: Preview data is not ready yet; holes and spokes remain hidden until it is available.
review.backendRejectedDetail: Preview data did not pass validation, so drawing stopped to avoid a misleading result.
review.previewDetailStraightPull: The {holes}H {cross}X straight-pull topology preview is ready.
review.previewDetailG3StraightPull: The {holes}H G3 straight-pull topology preview is ready.

seo.title: Wheelset spoke lacing topology and geometry reference
seo.description: An independent interactive preview for rim-hole mapping, 21H G3 2:1, uniform-hole 18H/24H 2:1, and 0X–4X lacing. Review a real build against measured data and manufacturer specifications.
